title: §17 feed pipeline, fixtures, feed page, initial data
goal: `npm run fetch` implements exactly the §17 sources (24 registry entries from design.md's probe table) with honest per-source health in data/meta.json, tests run on recorded fixtures only, the Feed page renders data/feed.json with filters, triage and health, and the repo carries an initial data set from one local run.
description: sources.config.mjs, src/feed/{http,normalize,pipeline}.js, src/feed/parsers/*, scripts/fetch.mjs, fixtures + README, tests, assets/feed.js + assets/lib/filter.js, the full feed.html template (OF-1, OF-6, OF-11, DR-5, DR-9), the `feed` check group in scripts/audit.py, and the committed data/feed.json + data/meta.json from the local proof run.
steps: Read FIRST: context.json, this file, plan.md Decisions 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, 16, 17, 19, 26, 27, design.md 'Feed' and '§17 source list and probe results' (the registry is that table), content/roadmap.md §17.1–17.6, §13.6, §10.4, §11.1, ORCHESTRATOR FINDINGS OF-1/OF-6/OF-11, reviews/design-verdict.json DR-5 and DR-9, mocks/feed.html, probe-pc-2026-10-20.json, the Ahead reference src/http.js, scripts/fetch.mjs, tests/helpers.js and tests/fixtures/README.md (patterns only; write this repo's own code), FEAT-001…004 findings.

`npm install fast-xml-parser@5.11.2 --save-exact` (second and last dependency). sources.config.mjs: one object literal per source, registry order = design table order: arxiv-cs.RO, arxiv-eess.SY (export API `search_query=cat:…`, max_results 100, §17.3 include rule applied), arxiv-q-thesis-narrow, arxiv-q-aerial-autonomy, arxiv-q-safe-autonomy, arxiv-q-robot-learning-eval (the four §17.3 queries verbatim, max_results 50), rss-proceedings (https://www.roboticsproceedings.org/rss22/index.html, kind rss-proceedings, volumeDate 2026-07-13, note 'yearly volume'), pmlr-corl (https://proceedings.mlr.press/v305/assets/rss/feed.xml, note 'yearly volume'), lab-cmu-ri (https://www.ri.cmu.edu/feed/, maxBytes 2 MB, filter = union of the three §17.3 include regexes, note 'filtered: §17.3 include terms (the §17.5 aerial/safety/learning filter)' — Decision 16), lab-bair, lab-grasp (https://www.grasp.upenn.edu/news/feed/), rel-ros2, rel-px4, rel-mujoco, rel-gz-sim, rel-nav2, rel-qgc, rel-mavsdk (github releases.atom), reg-nist (https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/rss.xml with /robot|autonomous system|AI risk|assurance|test and evaluation|safety/i, note 'provisional: Cloudflare-served'), reg-dgca, reg-moca, reg-egazette, reg-digitalsky, reg-aai-aim (kind reachability, class regulator, the §13.6 URLs). Fields: id, name, class (arxiv|proceedings|lab|release|regulator), kind (arxiv|atomrss|rss-proceedings|reachability), url, label (for matchedQuery), maxItems (60; queries 50), optional filter/include, note, timeoutMs.

src/feed/http.js (Ahead's pattern rewritten): browser-like Chrome UA, Accept 'application/atom+xml, application/rss+xml, application/xml;q=0.9, text/html;q=0.8, */*;q=0.7', Accept-Language; `redirect: 'manual'` with ≤5 hops; timeout 15 s for export.arxiv.org and 20 s elsewhere (per-source override); one retry after 2 s on network error, timeout, 429 (Retry-After honoured ≤30 s), 5xx, and 404 from github.com atom; body cap 8 MB default; classes HttpError(status, url, detail with server/cf-ray/cf-mitigated/content-type/300-char body snippet), TimeoutError, BodyTooLarge, ParseError(kind); `redactKey(text)` replaces the value of any `key=` query parameter and any `Authorization: <value>` in every message, URL and detail BEFORE slicing; `errorSummary(err)` → ≤120 chars ('HTTP 403', 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare' when server header says cloudflare, 'timeout', 'tls: <code>' for TLS errors such as UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE, 'parse error: xml', 'network'); per-host pacing export.arxiv.org 3000 ms, github.com 1000 ms; `createHttpClient({ fetchImpl, sleep, nowMs })` so tests inject everything.

Parsers: arxiv.js (Atom via fast-xml-parser: id → arXiv id without version, title, summary, published, updated (publishedAt = updated), categories, abs link); atomrss.js (Atom entry and RSS item: title, link/href, published|updated|pubDate|dc:date, summary|content|description|content:encoded with HTML stripped); rss-proceedings.js (regex over `Title` on the volume index; publishedAt = registry volumeDate; url = volume base + pNNN.html); reachability.js (GET, status only, no items).

src/feed/normalize.js: canonical URL (lowercase scheme/host, strip utm_*/ref/fbclid and fragments, trailing slash except root, arXiv abs/IDvN → abs/ID); id = 'arxiv:<id>' when present else 'url:<first 16 hex of sha1(canonical)>'; title whitespace-collapsed; summary = plain text ≤300 chars cut at a word boundary with '…' (never '...'), after stripping HTML, collapsing whitespace and dropping lines starting 'Signed-off-by:' or 'Co-authored-by:'; dates → ISO (invalid → dropped and counted in skipped); window = publishedAt ≥ now − 30 days; §17.3 include rule for the two category listings only: keep when (rule 1 OR rule 3) AND rule 2 match title+summary (the three regex lines from §17.3, case-insensitive); per-source `filter` regex (NIST, CMU) applied to title+summary; matchedQuery = first matching registry label, alsoMatched = the others.

src/feed/pipeline.js: `run({ sources, now, dataDir, fetchImpl, dryRun, onlySourceIds, runner })`; concurrency 4 with the per-host pacing; per source: fetch → parse → normalize → window → filter → cap maxItems → source result {status ok|empty|failed, fetched, kept, ms, httpStatus, newestAt, error, note}; merge with the previous data/feed.json (items still inside the window kept; same id replaced by the fresh copy); dedupe by id; sort publishedAt desc; global cap 500 (Decision 6); write feed.json {generatedAt, windowDays:30, items:[{id,title,url,source,sourceId,sourceClass,publishedAt,summary,matchedQuery,alsoMatched}]} and meta.json {generatedAt, durationMs, windowDays, itemCount, newItemCount, runner (process.env.FEED_RUNNER || 'local' — Decision 27), sources:{id:{name,class,kind,status,fetched,kept,ms,httpStatus,checkedAt,newestAt,error,unavailableSince,note}}} atomically (.tmp + rename); `unavailableSince` carried forward from the previous meta while a source keeps failing and cleared on success; exit code 0 even when sources fail; 1 only when the registry cannot load, writing fails, or every network source failed (print a `::warning::` line); total wall-clock cap 8 min, per-source deadline 45 s. scripts/fetch.mjs: flags --data-dir, --dry-run, --now, --source (diagnostic subset, requires --dry-run); prints the Ahead-style per-source table and the 'ok N · empty N · failed N · items N' line.

Fixtures: capture ONCE with a scratch script in $env:TEMP (never in the repo) from the real sources, trim, and save under tests/fixtures/feed/: arxiv-api-cs.RO.xml (10 entries), arxiv-q-thesis-narrow.xml (as served; empty-in-window), arxiv-q-aerial.xml (10), gh-releases-px4.xml (4), gh-releases-mujoco.xml (3), cmu-ri.xml (5 items, keep the envelope), grasp-news.xml (5), bair-blog.xml (3), pmlr-v305.xml (5), nist-news.xml (5), rss22-index.html (trimmed to ~15 paper links keeping the page structure), cloudflare-403.html (a short block-page snippet with a cf-ray style marker). Write tests/fixtures/feed/README.md with the Ahead-style table (file, upstream capture, items, note) and the sentence that fixtures are byte-exact captures never edited by hand. Total under 1.5 MB. Remove the scratch script and raw captures from $env:TEMP afterwards.

Tests (no network: tests/helpers.js maps every registry URL to a fixture and throws on unmapped URLs; one pipeline test additionally sets `globalThis.fetch` to a function that throws): http (retry plan, Retry-After cap, timeout → TimeoutError, redirect hops, github 404 retry, body cap, redactKey on key= and Authorization, errorSummary classes incl. Cloudflare 403 detail), parsers (each fixture → expected item counts, ids, dates, summaries; rss-proceedings volumeDate), normalize (canonical URL cases, arXiv id version strip, summary truncation at a word boundary with '…', ≤300, Signed-off-by removal, window, §17.3 include rule on listings only, NIST and CMU filters, matchedQuery/alsoMatched), pipeline (fixture run → statuses: queries ok/empty as the fixtures imply, pmlr-corl empty, reachability ok on 200 and failed on a thrown TLS error with errorSummary 'tls: UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE'; merge-with-previous keeps in-window items and replaces same ids; unavailableSince carry-forward and clear; meta shape; atomic write into a temp dir; exit semantics; --source subset requires --dry-run), filter (client: class/query/triage filters, sort, counts), feed-template (DR-5: every td text of the protocol card equals a cell string of the §17.1 table; three Normal-week rows + one month-end/quarter-end line; health glyph strings '■ ok', '□ empty', '✕ failed').

Feed page template (src/build/templates.js, mock feed.html as the visual contract): kicker 'Stay ahead · the §17 monitoring system, fetched daily', h1 'Feed', line 'Last updated · 30-day window · GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs.', health `
` whose summary is filled by JS as '■ ok N · □ empty N · ✕ failed N · N sources · details' (DR-9: a space after each glyph) and whose body is a table Source / Class / Status / Fetched / Newest item / Note or error with failed rows reading 'Unavailable since · '; rule card 'Keep only if it changes an experiment or a claim.' + link s17.html#s17-6; filter rows (Class: All/arXiv/Proceedings/Labs/Releases/Regulators; Query: the four §17.3 labels + 'Category listings'; Triage: Everything/Kept N/Read later N/Dropped N) with aria-pressed; `
    `; right column: 'Weekly protocol' built at BUILD time from the §17.1 table's three Normal-week rows (the source's own cells: first cell 'Normal week' on the first row, blank on the next two; Minutes, Action, Hard output) plus the line 'Month-end 90 min · Quarter-end 120 min — see §17.1' linking s17.html#s17-1 — NO added row numbers (DR-5; build-time assertion that every td text is a §17.1 cell string), the §17.6 limits line; 'Indian official notices: check manually' card (the §13.6 links: DGCA portal, Ministry of Civil Aviation rules + the search terms, eGazette, AAI Digital Sky, AAI AIM/NOTAM; each with its last reachability status + date filled by JS from meta, failures as 'Unavailable since · '); 'Labs without a feed: check monthly' (UZH RPG, ETH ASL, IIIT-H RRC, Stanford ASL); one 'Manual checks' line linking s17.html#s17-3 (Scholar / Semantic Scholar alerts), s17.html#s17-4 (venue watchlist), s17.html#s17-5 (benchmark watches), s13.html#s13-6 (regulator comparators) — Decision 17. Noscript: link to data/feed.json.

assets/feed.js + assets/lib/filter.js: fetch data/feed.json and data/meta.json with cache 'no-cache'; render items newest first (title link rel noopener external + .dom, source name, formatDate, matchedQuery or class, summary, Keep / Read later / Drop buttons with aria-pressed); `.feed-item` is a grid (OF-1): titles always left-aligned, actions in the fixed right column from 820, one horizontal row at the top-right from 1440 (OF-11), stacked column 820–1439, below the meta row under 820; dropped items hidden unless the 'Dropped N' filter is active (Decision 6); triage persists under KEYS.triage {id:{state, at}}; counts in the triage chips update live; 'Showing N of M items in the window' line; health strip from meta.sources; [data-last-updated] from formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt).

Local proof run: `node scripts/fetch.mjs --data-dir "$env:TEMP\pair-feed"` → inspect the table (expected from the design: ok ≈17 · empty ≈6 · failed 1 (eGazette tls)); then `node scripts/fetch.mjs` into data/ and keep the result for the commit (runner 'local'). Remove $env:TEMP\pair-feed. Rebuild so dist/data carries the real files.

scripts/audit.py GROUPS['feed'] (with the real data): at 390/820/1024/1440/1920/2560 no two child boxes of any `.feed-item` intersect and every title's left edge equals the item content edge; at ≥1440 the three triage buttons of the first item share one `top` and `left` > title `right`; at 820–1439 three distinct tops, all right of the content column; at <820 the actions' top > the meta row's bottom; health summary text matches /■ ok \d+ · □ empty \d+ · ✕ failed \d+/; every source with status failed renders a row containing 'Unavailable since'; no `.summary` text ends with '...'; clicking Class 'Releases' changes the visible item count to the number of release items; clicking Keep on the first item sets aria-pressed=true and survives reload; Drop hides the item until 'Dropped N' is active; protocol card: exactly 3 tbody rows and no cell text that is not a §17.1 cell string (pass the §17.1 cells from verify.mjs); '[data-last-updated]' text equals formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt) computed in the audit from data/meta.json and the page text contains 'GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs'; DOM text of the first 5 items equals the JSON titles/sources/dates (D6); index.html 'Latest from the feed' lists 5 items whose titles are in feed.json.

Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify` (feed group included). Fix ANY hard-UI-rule violation found on ANY page, in scope or not, and report it. Update status.md, set this file's status to completed, record findings: the local per-source table (ok/empty/failed with error classes), feed.json item count and size, fixture sizes, any source whose runner status is uncertain (NIST).
Commit on main: `feat(FEAT-005): §17 feed pipeline, fixtures, feed page, initial data` with the commands, the per-source table and results in the body. Never push.

acceptance.outcome: The pipeline fetches exactly the §17 sources and records honest health (D8, D6).
acceptance.audit: `node scripts/fetch.mjs --data-dir $env:TEMP\pair-feed` prints 24 rows with status ok/empty/failed and an error class for each failure (eGazette 'tls: …'); meta.json has every design field; tests/pipeline.test.js passes on fixtures with no network.
tests/helpers.js throws on unmapped URLs; the pipeline test with a throwing globalThis.fetch passes.

acceptance.outcome: Feed items lay out without overlap at every width (OF-1, OF-11).
acceptance.audit: feed group: 0 intersecting child boxes per .feed-item and aligned titles at 390/820/1024/1440/1920/2560; action placement per width band.

acceptance.outcome: Health and failures are visible and honest (D6, DR-9).
acceptance.audit: health summary regex with spaced glyphs; every failed source shows 'Unavailable since <date> · <error class>'; no summary ends with '...'.

acceptance.outcome: The weekly protocol card is compact and adds no numbers (OF-6, DR-5).
acceptance.audit: 3 tbody rows + the month-end/quarter-end line; every td text ⊂ §17.1 cells (build-time assertion + audit).

acceptance.outcome: Filters and triage work and persist.
acceptance.audit: class filter changes the count; Keep aria-pressed survives reload; Drop hides until 'Dropped N'.

acceptance.outcome: Freshness is derived once and worded as required (D9).
acceptance.audit: [data-last-updated] == formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt); 'GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs' present on feed and index.

acceptance.outcome: The repo carries real initial data.
acceptance.audit: data/feed.json items > 0 with real titles/dates; data/meta.json runner 'local'; index 'Latest from the feed' shows 5 real items.

acceptance_criteria: npm test passes with fixtures only
node scripts/fetch.mjs runs locally and writes data/feed.json + data/meta.json
npm run verify exits 0 with the feed group
fixtures under tests/fixtures/feed/ total < 1.5 MB with a README table
verification: node scripts/fetch.mjs --data-dir "$env:TEMP\pair-feed" ; then node scripts/fetch.mjs ; Remove-Item -Recurse "$env:TEMP\pair-feed"
mandatoryReviewItems: DR-5: protocol card cells ⊂ §17.1 cell strings; no added row numbers (build-time assertion + audit).
DR-9: '■ ok N · □ empty N · ✕ failed N' spacing; summaries end with '…' never '...'.
OF-1: feed-item grid geometry audit, 0 overlaps, aligned titles at six widths.
OF-6: protocol card = three Normal-week rows + one month-end/quarter-end line linking §17.1.
OF-11: horizontal action row ≥1440, stacked 820–1439, below meta <820.
D6: failed sources shown as 'Unavailable since <date> · <error class>'; real titles/dates/sources; no generated summaries.
D8: NIST provisional with its note; the ship step applies Decision 8.
commit: feat(FEAT-005): §17 feed pipeline, fixtures, feed page, initial data
findings: COMMIT: feat(FEAT-005) on main = e9acbe9a299333adf2ec48f738aff796086e781d (53 files, 10991 insertions, 11749 deletions — the deletions are the rewritten docs/verify-report.json); this hash was recorded by the follow-up docs(FEAT-005) commit because a commit cannot contain its own hash.

BUILD SUMMARY (npm run build): pages 28 · h3 89 · chips 127 · crossrefs 113 rewritten / 5 skipped · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 · search 965 records · bytes 1375657. node_modules 3.26 MB after `npm install fast-xml-parser@5.11.2 --save-exact` (adds strnum 2.5.1 and @nodable/entities; nothing else). Disk 3.4 GB free.

TESTS: npm test = 136 tests / 30 files, all pass, ≈4 s, no network: tests/helpers.js maps every one of the 24 registry URLs to a fixture (19 captures, 4 generated 200 reachability pages, eGazette = the probe's TLS error reproduced as TypeError("fetch failed", { cause: { code: "UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE" } })) and throws on any other URL; the main pipeline test additionally installs a throwing globalThis.fetch for the whole run. New: http (8: redactKey key=/Authorization, errorSummary classes ≤120 incl. "blocked: 403 Cloudflare" via server header or cf-ray, timeouts 15 s arXiv / 20 s elsewhere, pacing 3 s / 1 s, redirects ≤5 with browser headers, retry plan 5xx/429 (Retry-After capped 30 s)/network/github 404 and no retry on 403/404/body cap or near the deadline, hanging response → TimeoutError with timeoutMs 30, 4xx detail with server/cf-ray/content-type/300-char body), parsers (5: arXiv ids/abs links/updated/categories, GitHub releases, WordPress/Jekyll/Drupal/PMLR RSS, RSS XXII index with volumeDate, reachability), normalize (6: queries and include rules verbatim in content/roadmap.md, canonical URL cases, ids, summaries ≤300 with …, dates/window, include rule and NIST/CMU filters, normalizeSource on fixtures), pipeline (6: statuses ok 16 · empty 7 · failed 1 on fixtures, 30 deduped items with matchedQuery/alsoMatched by registry order, reachability ok/failed, meta shape with every design field, merge with a previous feed/meta incl. unavailableSince carry-forward and clear and atomic .tmp+rename, Cloudflare 403 and non-XML body as failed rows, exit 1 only when every source failed, --source requires --dry-run, caps 500/60/50), filter (4: client filters/sort/counts/health strings against the real data/meta.json), feed-template (4: DR-5 cells, §17.6/§13.6/§17.5 verbatim, header/health/rule/filter strings, build failures on a reshaped §17.1 table).

Per source (status · fetched · kept · http · newest · note/error): arxiv-cs.RO ok 100/5 200 2026-10-20 "filtered by the §17.3 include rules"; arxiv-eess.SY ok 100/1 200 2026-10-20 same; arxiv-q-thesis-narrow empty 33/0 200 2026-07-21; arxiv-q-aerial-autonomy ok 50/12 200 2026-10-17; arxiv-q-safe-autonomy ok 50/40 200 2026-10-20; arxiv-q-robot-learning-eval ok 50/50 200 2026-10-20; rss-proceedings empty 210/0 200 2026-07-13 "yearly volume"; pmlr-corl empty 263/0 200 2025-10-07 "yearly volume"; lab-cmu-ri empty 100/0 200 2026-10-15 "filtered: §17.3 include terms (the §17.5 aerial/safety/learning filter)"; lab-bair empty 10/0 200 2026-07-29; lab-grasp ok 10/10 200 2026-10-20; rel-ros2 empty 10/0 200 2026-09-14; rel-px4 empty 10/0 200 2026-09-10; rel-mujoco ok 10/3 200 2026-10-14; rel-gz-sim ok 10/2 200 2026-10-20; rel-nav2 ok 10/2 200 2026-10-17; rel-qgc ok 10/1 200 2026-10-01; rel-mavsdk ok 10/7 200 2026-10-08; reg-nist ok 40/1 200 2026-10-16 "provisional: Cloudflare-served; filtered with the §17.5 terms"; reg-dgca ok 200; reg-moca ok 200; reg-egazette FAILED "tls: UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE" (unavailableSince 2026-10-21T14:08:28Z); reg-digitalsky ok 200; reg-aai-aim ok 200. DEVIATION FROM THE DESIGN EXPECTATION (ok 17 · empty 6 · failed 1): CMU RI is `empty`, not `ok` — the probe counted 9 in-window items before the §17.5 filter (plan Decision 16 = the union of the three §17.3 include lines) and none of the 100 feed items in the window matches it (the newest matching post is 2026-09-03 "Bringing Images to Life Through Touch", outside the window). The filter is the one the report defines; the status is honest. Everything else matched the prediction. HARD-UI-RULE FIX BEYOND THE FEAT LIST: FEAT-002's `.feed-item.dropped { opacity: 0.6 }` would have composited the muted meta text (#4f5862 on #fff) to ≈2.8:1 and the link colour below 4.5:1 whenever the Dropped filter shows dropped items (D3 AA). Replaced by a strike-through title in --fg-2 (no opacity); measured in the feedDropHides special: min pair 4.87 light / 7.12 dark in the dropped state. Also fixed while building (introduced here, caught by the screenshots): the 4-column protocol table inherited `overflow-wrap: anywhere` from body and broke "Normal week" / "deferred" into letters at 390 px (now `overflow-wrap: normal` + `min-width: 0` for table.protocol cells); filter rows wrapped their buttons under the label (now a two-track grid: label column + wrapping button row); the eGazette failure line wrapped into a 5-line column on the notices card at 1920 (failed notices now take their own full-width line from 720 px).

DECISIONS TAKEN HERE (not covered by D1–D11 / plan Decisions): (a) the §17.6 limits line is the verbatim "Limits: …" sentence of §17.6 (≈640 chars, with its code span), extracted at build time, followed by a §17.6 link — the mock abbreviated it, which D6/D11 forbid; (b) the rule card reads "Keep only if it changes an experiment or a claim. Triage is stored in this browser; the full keep/drop rule is in §17.6." — the mock's "Everything else is a drop." paraphrased §17.6 and was dropped; (c) item meta = source name · date · (matched query, or the class label, only when the source name does not already carry it — D5 each fact once) · "also <other matching queries>"; (d) matchedQuery owner on a duplicate id = the first matching registry entry in registry order (design text), so an item in both the cs.RO listing and a query reads "arXiv cs.RO listing · also Robot-learning evaluation"; (e) the Query filter is a toggle (press again to clear; none pressed = all), Class and Triage are single-select with All/Everything; (f) the notices card is built from the registry's five reachability sources with the §13.6 wording after each link rendered verbatim (DGCA: "What's New" and RPAS/UAS material; MoCA: the five search terms as code) — eGazette's parenthetical about the old egazette.nic.in hostname is a probe note and is not shown; the build asserts each registry URL equals the §13.6 link; (g) the labs card names the four labs with the report's own link texts (UZH RPG, ETH ASL, IIIT Hyderabad RRC, Stanford ASL) and URLs extracted from the §17.5 "Lab feeds:" paragraph; (h) HTTP timeouts are real timers (setTimeout) and only pacing/backoff use the injectable `sleep`, so a test clock that skips waits cannot fire a timeout; (i) a parse failure after a 200 keeps httpStatus 200 in meta.json with error "parse error: xml"; (j) network errors carry their code ("network: ECONNRESET"), TLS codes are "tls: <code>", a run past the 8-min wall clock marks the remaining sources "wall clock"; (k) the cs.RO fixture keeps entries 1–7 plus 31, 42, 67 (three pass the include rule) — documented in the fixtures README; DATA / META SHAPES: data/feed.json {generatedAt, windowDays: 30, items[{id, title, url, source, sourceId, sourceClass, publishedAt, summary, matchedQuery, alsoMatched}]} sorted publishedAt desc then id; data/meta.json {generatedAt, durationMs, windowDays, itemCount, newItemCount, runner, sources{id: {name, class, kind, status, fetched, kept, ms, httpStatus, checkedAt, newestAt, error, unavailableSince, note}}} in registry order; `runner` = process.env.FEED_RUNNER || "local" (FEAT-006 sets FEED_RUNNER=github-actions in the workflow). The pipeline keeps previous in-window items whose source failed this run and replaces same-id items with the fresh copy; `unavailableSince` is carried forward while a source keeps failing and cleared on success. Exit codes: 0 even with failed sources; 1 when the registry is invalid, a write fails, every source failed (a ::warning:: line is printed and nothing is written), or the flags are invalid (--source without --dry-run, bad --now).

CLIENT API: assets/feed.js init() (app.js PAGE_MODULES.feed) renders into [data-feed-list] and sets data-feed-ready="ok"|"error" on it when done (the audit waits for it); items are li.feed-item[data-id][data-class] > h3 > a[rel="noopener external"] + span.dom, div.meta > span.src + span.date + span.tag*, p.summary (omitted when empty), div.triage > button[data-triage=keep|later|drop][aria-pressed]; dropped items get .dropped; filter buttons button[data-filter=class|query|triage][data-value][aria-pressed]; counts in [data-count=keep|later|drop]; health summary in [data-health-summary] (the "· details" suffix is static), rows in [data-health-rows] tr[data-status]; notices li[data-notice][data-status] > [data-notice-status]; "Last updated" in [data-last-updated] via formatLastUpdated. assets/lib/filter.js (pure): CLASS_LABELS, TRIAGE_STATES, LISTINGS, HEALTH_GLYPHS, sortNewest, triageOf, nextTriage, withTriage, labelsOf, matchesQuery, applyFilters(items, triage, {cls, query, tri}), triageCounts, statusLine, healthCounts, healthSummary, unavailableText, noteOrError, noticeStatus, hostLabel.
